messages:
Mia: Heads up — VoiceOver reads the canary pill twice when the variant row is collapsed. Heard: 'Canary 10 percent. Canary 10 percent.' :eyes: Sam: Repro'd on macOS + Safari. Happens when the pill is programme-hidden but still in DOM. :bug: Jia: Screenshot? I couldn't repro on Chrome with NVDA. Might be VoiceOver-specific focus/aria order bug. Mia: Screenshot + quick recording: https://files.internal/clip123.mov Oliver: Likely the aria-live region announcing the pill plus the collapsed row aria-label. We probably have both aria-live and a hidden label announcing the same thing. Aisha: Also noticed the rollback CTA is "Rollback" — screen readers get no context about what will happen. Suggest: aria-label="Rollback to version v1.2.3 — reverts traffic and stops canary" Sam: Agree on rollback ARIA. Also microcopy question: Should the button say "Pause rollout" or "Pause canary"? Product intent is to pause that variant only. Mia: Prefer "Pause canary" for accuracy. Customers can get confused if they think the whole deployment is paused. Jia: For the double-announcement, quick fix idea: ensure collapsed row has aria-hidden="true" OR move the pill announcement into a single aria-live region that only updates once. Oliver: Proposed snippet to try in canary row component: ``` Canary allocation updated to 10%
Canary 10%
``` Sam: Looks sensible. We should test VoiceOver + NVDA after patch. Put behind feature flag for canary UI so Dedicated customers aren't impacted until validated. Aisha: Accessibility nit: keyboard focus outline disappears on the small variant pills (high contrast mode). Need 2px solid focus ring in theme tokens. Mia: Also: timeline scrubber — when you scrub to a previous version and press rollback, the confirmation modal reads the wrong timestamp (reads current time). Think the time string is pulling from Date.now() instead of the selected snapshot. Jia: That's a bug — I'll add a unit test and update the modal to use selectedSnapshot.timeISO. Oliver: UX microcopy suggestion for confirm modal: header "Confirm rollback to snapshot — 2025-06-12 14:03 UTC" and primary button "Rollback to snapshot" (not just "Confirm"). Aisha: +1 on explicit button copy. Add an aria-describedby that references the inline explanation: "This action will revert traffic and restart the variant. Metrics will be preserved." Sam: I'll make a tiny PR with three changes: 1) collapse announcement de-dupe, 2) explicit rollback aria-label + button copy, 3) focus ring for variant pills. Assigning to @Jia for modal time bug. DesignBot: Accessibility scan queued: ADA-AR-2025 (duplicate live region) — severity medium. Mia: Thanks — can we get a quick UX review after the PR? I'll test VoiceOver path. Sam: ETA PR tomorrow afternoon. Leaving a checklist in the PR for VoiceOver/NVDA/manual test steps. :thumbsup: Jia: Got it. I'll own testing and merge after verification. Mia: Awesome — great catch everyone.
__notes: Follow-up: filename uses unique wording about screen reader double-announcement + rollback copy. Thread is short, Slack-style, includes code snippet and emoji, participants are plausible internal names.
